note: Canonical label set for the github-workflow skill. Names and colours are the contract. Repo-specific area:* labels come from docs/process/labels.md, not from here.

area_prefix.rule: at least one per issue; multiple allowed; closed set per repo

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something isn't working

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: New feature or improvement

labels.name: chore
labels.description: Maintenance — deps, refactor, lint, build, infra

labels.name: epic
labels.description: Meta-issue tracking a multi-issue / multi-PR goal

labels.name: documentation
labels.description: Docs-only work, or a found docs gap — coexists with a type

labels.name: question
labels.description: Further information is requested

labels.name: help
labels.description: Requires human intervention — agent is blocked

labels.name: severity:critical
labels.description: Breaks runtime, blocks merge, or causes data loss

labels.name: severity:major
labels.description: Affects a core path but has a workaround

labels.name: severity:minor
labels.description: Cosmetic, edge case, or low-frequency

labels.name: priority:high
labels.description: Sequencing — pull this ahead of other work

labels.name: priority:medium
labels.description: Sequencing — normal ordering

labels.name: priority:low
labels.description: Sequencing — do after higher-priority work

labels.name: regression
labels.description: A previously-fixed issue has returned, or a recent change broke something that worked

labels.name: backlog
labels.description: Intentionally shelved; mirrors the board's Backlog column — not sequenced into any milestone

labels.name: deferred
labels.description: Provenance: filed as out-of-scope by an agent during other work; stays on the issue

labels.name: concern:style
labels.description: Found-issue dimension — style / formatting / naming drift

labels.name: concern:lint
labels.description: Found-issue dimension — linter warning not blocked on

labels.name: concern:tests
labels.description: Found-issue dimension — missing/thin tests or coverage gap

labels.name: concern:refactor
labels.description: Found-issue dimension — code smell, duplication, dead code

labels.name: concern:perf
labels.description: Found-issue dimension — performance / inefficiency

labels.name: concern:security
labels.description: Found-issue dimension — non-blocking or pre-existing security concern
